title: SDE 2 Python
description:
We are seeking talented, driven individuals with a passion for tackling complex challenges and a strong desire to learn. As part of our engineering team, you will play a key role in orchestrating, deploying, and maintaining scalable and efficient applications.

To excel in this role, you'll need experience in developing server-side logic and working on back-end solutions.

Join us and be part of a team that thrives on innovation and impact!

**Job Responsibilities**

1. Write reusable, testable, and efficient code.
2. Design and implement low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications.
3. Design and create RESTful APIs for internal and partner consumption.
4. Implement security and data protection.
5. Debug code on the platform (written by self or others) to find the root cause of any ongoing issues and rectify them.
6. Database query optimization & design and implement scalable database schemas that represent and support business processes.
7. Implement web applications in Python, SQL, Javascript, HTML, and CSS.
8. Provide technical leadership to teammates through coaching and mentorship.
9. Delegate tasks and set deadlines.
10. Monitor team performance and report on performance.
11. Collaborate with other software developers, business analysts to plan, design and develop applications.
12. Maintain client relationships and ensure Company deliverables meet highest expectations of the client.

**Mandatory Skills**

1. 4+ years of experience in Python Development.
2. Hands-on exp with any of the Python frameworks: Django/Flask/FastAPI.
3. Solid database skills in relational databases.
4. Knowledge of how to build and use RESTful APIs.
5. Strong knowledge of version control.
6. Hands-on experience on working on Linux systems.
7. Familiarity with ORM (Object Relational Mapper) libraries. Experience with SQL Alchemy is a plus.
8. Knowledge of Redis.
9. Strong understanding of peer review best practices.
10. Hands-on experience in deployment processes.

**Good to have Skills**

1. Proficiency in AWS, Azure, or GCP (any one).
2. Experience with Docker.

title: Lead Software Engineer/Principal Software Engineer
description:
**About the Company:**

ProductSquads was founded with a bold mission: to engineer capital efficiency through autonomous AI agents, exceptional engineering, and real-time decision intelligence. We're building an AI-native platform that redefines how software teams deliver value — whether through code written by humans, agents, or both. Our stack combines agentic AI systems, ML pipelines, and high-performance engineering workflows. This is your chance to build not just models, but systems that think, decide, and act — AI fabric tools, domain-intelligent agents, and real-time decision systems that power the next generation of product delivery.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced and innovative Lead Software Engineer/Principal Software Engineer. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and high-performance applications using Microsoft .NET, Python and React technologies. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet our business needs. A successful candidate will be a highly motivated self-learner with a strong desire to continuously expand their knowledge and skill set, actively seeking out new information and technologies to stay ahead in a fast-paced industry.

**Responsibilities:**

* Drive architecture and technical direction for a major product area, with minimal oversight.
* Influence technical standards across the team.
* Design, develop, and maintain AWS cloud based applications using React JS, .NET framework and related technologies (e.g., ASP.NET, .NET Core), and Python.
* Write clean, scalable, and efficient code following best practices and coding standards.
* Collaborate with team members to define project requirements, scope, and objectives.
* Develop APIs and integrate third-party services where required.
* Ensure software quality through comprehensive testing, debugging, and troubleshooting.
* Advocate for test-driven development (TDD) and automated testing practices.
* Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.
* Participate in code reviews, team meetings, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Stay updated with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies to ensure solutions remain current.
* Provide technical support and resolve application-related issues as needed.
* Evaluate AI-assisted development practices (e.g., AI pair-programming, automated code review, test generation) to raise engineering productivity and code quality across the team.

**Why Join us:**

* Develop hands-on skills working on cutting-edge technology projects.
* Benefit from a collaborative and supportive work environment.
* Contribute to major IT initiatives and help drive technology improvements across the company.
* This is an exciting opportunity to work with and learn from experienced engineering leaders and make an impact at a growing company.

**Who you are:**

* You have excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication skills and teamwork abilities.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
* You seek initiative and undertake self-development activities.
* You thrive in fast-paced environments, are flexible and able to roll with changing scenarios.

**Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.

**Required Skills:**

* 8+ years of professional experience in .NET development with at least 2 years in a cloud-based environment, preferably AWS.
* Proficiency in C# and the .NET framework (including .NET Core) with current hands on experience in .NET version 5+. Knowledge of .NET version 4+ is a plus.
* Experience with ASP.NET, MVC, and Web API development.
* Proficient in Core Python, Flask, Django, FastAPI, ORM, Async programming, Scripting and automation.
* Proficient in HTML, React JS, CSS, TypeScript, JavaScript, GraphQL.
* Hands on experience in designing and implementing RESTful APIs and microservices.
* Hands on experience in at least one major RDBMS: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc. and NoSQL: MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, etc., database design, and writing complex queries.
* Experience in AWS Services, such as EC2, S3, RDS, Aurora, ECS, Lambda, etc.
* Experience in containerization tools like Docker and orchestration platforms such as ECS, Kubernetes.
* Experience working with DevOps tools and practices (e.g., CI/CD pipelines and associated tooling).
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) across the SDLC - spec-to-code generation, automated code review, test generation, debugging, and documentation - with a track record of measurable productivity gains.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP), design patterns and SOLID principles.
* Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Bitbucket, Git).
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with various ETL tools such as Pentaho, AWS Glue, Keboola, etc.
* Experience with AI/ML tools and frameworks, SageMaker, etc.
* AWS Certified Developer Associate.
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate.
* Microsoft Certifications relevant to the job requirements.

title: Senior Drupal Developer – Contractual Opportunity
description:
E2logy Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a skilled Drupal Developer with 4+ years of hands-on experience to join our development team in Ahmedabad.
  
This is an initial
**six-month contractual opportunity**
, with the possibility of extension based on project requirements, individual performance, and business needs.
  
We particularly encourage applications from candidates who are currently available, between jobs, freelancing, or able to join within 15 days.
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop, customize, and maintain Drupal-based websites and applications.
* Build and maintain custom Drupal modules using PHP
* Work with Drupal 9/10/11, including configuration management and content modelling is an added advantage.
* Support Drupal upgrades, migrations, and application enhancements.
* Develop and integrate REST APIs and third-party services.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and optimize application performance.
* Collaborate with developers, designers, and project stakeholders.
* Maintain clean, secure, and well-documented code.

Requirements
  
  

* 4+ years of hands-on experience in Drupal development.
* Strong experience with Drupal 9 or 10 ia Added Advantage
* Proficiency in PHP, object-oriented programming, and MySQL.
* Experience developing and customizing Drupal modules.
* Working knowledge of Composer, Drush, and Git.
* Familiarity with Twig templating and Drupal theming.
* Understanding of Drupal architecture, entities, content types, and configuration management.
* Experience integrating APIs and troubleshooting Drupal applications.

* Experience with Drupal 7 to Drupal 9/10 migrations.
* Knowledge of Drupal Migrate API.
* Exposure to Drupal 11.
* Experience with Symfony components.
* Experience with Drupal performance optimization and security best practices.

* Professionals currently between jobs or who have recently completed their previous employment.
* Freelancers available for a full-time contractual assignment.
* Candidates whose existing contracts are ending shortly.

Benefits

* Collaborative Teamwork and On-Site Office Requirements
* Flexibility for occasional extended hours to meet critical project timelines.

* Submit your resume and optionally a portfolio of academic projects or personal work to careers@e2logy.com

title: Lead Software Engineer -  C# / .NET
description:

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.
  
  
**The Role:**
We’re seeking a hands-on
**Lead Software Engineer**
to drive application modernization, legacy-codebase stabilization, service/API extraction, and secure integration initiatives. The role combines deep expertise in C#/.NET, Angular, and SQL Server with modern integration engineering using TypeScript/Node.js, gRPC/Protocol Buffers, PostgreSQL, and Microsoft Azure. Experience:
**8+ Years**

* Lead the design, development, modernization, and maintenance of enterprise applications using C#/.NET and Angular.
* Stabilize legacy codebases by addressing technical debt, reliability, performance, and maintainability.

* Design secure integrations between existing platforms and external systems, covering authentication, authorization, data protection, and error handling.
* Develop and optimize SQL Server queries, stored procedures, and application data-access layers.

* Troubleshoot complex application, cross-service, and data consistency issues and drive root-cause analysis to resolution.
* Lead architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews; establish coding standards, testing practices, and reusable development patterns.
* Collaborate with product owners, architects, and engineering teams to turn business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

*(all mandatory)*

* Minimum 8 years of experience in software development.

**Strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET Framework, and modern .NET.**

* Experience building and maintaining enterprise web applications using Angular.
* Strong SQL Server skills, including stored procedures, query optimization, and database troubleshooting.
* Proven experience stabilizing, refactoring, and improving existing enterprise applications.
* Experience extracting services from monolithic or legacy systems and designing maintainable APIs.
* Solid understanding of secure service communication, authentication, authorization, and data protection.
* Strong hands-on development experience with TypeScript/Node.js.
* Expertise in API design: RESTful APIs, service contracts, integration patterns, and versioning.
* Practical experience designing or implementing gRPC services and Protobuf contracts.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design, SQL, query optimization, and application integration.
* Experience deploying, integrating, and supporting application services on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong grasp of design patterns, clean code, testing, debugging, and version control (Git).
* Ability to lead design discussions, run architecture and code reviews, and mentor engineers.

**Other Employment Benefits**

* Family health insurance cover.
* Education / Certification reimbursement.
* Multiple leave types
* Flexible work schedule.
* Work from home policies.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, and we consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. If you require accommodation in the application process, please contact our HR

title: NetSuite Integration Architect
description:
**About the Company:**

Relay Human Cloud is a young & dynamic company that helps some of the top US-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting & Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high-quality operations in cutting-edge companies for their entire careers.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager – Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture with strong NetSuite integration expertise to design, develop, and maintain enterprise integrations, APIs, EDI, and data pipelines. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills and a solid understanding of distribution, inventory, order processing, and accounting workflows. This role focuses on hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, and long-term technical ownership rather than project management.

**Responsibilities:**

**Enterprise integration architecture**

* Design and maintain the company's enterprise integration architecture, including approved patterns for APIs, EDI, webhooks, SFTP, files, native connectors, events, and batch processing.
* Define source and target systems, authoritative data boundaries, field mappings, timing, sequencing, validation, error handling, retry, reconciliation, security, and support ownership for each interface.
* Avoid uncontrolled point-to-point connections, duplicated business logic, and integrations that create parallel systems of record.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, mapping specifications, decision records, and runbooks while determining which existing interfaces should be retained, redesigned, replaced, or retired.

**NetSuite integration engineering**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support integrations between NetSuite and internal or external systems.
* Develop deep knowledge of the NetSuite record, transaction, permission, and posting models so interfaces create valid operational and accounting results.
* Work with applicable NetSuite capabilities such as REST web services, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteScript, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, web services, and token-based authentication.
* Use Oracle integration technologies where appropriate, establish reusable engineering patterns, and challenge partner-proposed designs before owning the deployed solution and support model.

**Customer vendor and external ecosystem integration**

* Support EDI and API connectivity for customers, broadline distributors, vendors, logistics providers, marketplaces, payment services, websites, and other business partners.
* Design mappings and workflows for relevant documents such as purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory updates, item data, pricing, and order status.
* Support vendor onboarding, customer enablement, item synchronization, pricing exchange, order ingestion, fulfillment status, and other digital transaction flows while keeping partner-specific rules documented and controlled.
* Build repeatable onboarding patterns that reduce the cost and time required to connect new customers, vendors, and acquisitions.

**Data architecture ownership and governance**

* Help define company's enterprise data architecture with NetSuite as the authoritative transactional platform for the processes it owns.
* Establish clear boundaries for transactional, master, analytical, historical, reference, and external application data.
* Partner with business and application owners to define authoritative sources, data ownership, approval rights, stewardship, quality rules, and lifecycle requirements.
* Design governed data pipelines, transformation logic, shared definitions, and reconciliations so critical item, pricing, costing, inventory, margin, customer, vendor, and financial logic remains transparent and auditable.

**Legacy discovery migration and transition**

* Inspect legacy applications, databases, scripts, interfaces, files, and automated jobs to identify embedded business rules and technical dependencies.
* Document why existing functionality exists before replacing it, separating requirements that must be preserved from obsolete workarounds and technical debt.
* Support extraction, transformation, mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with repeatable utilities and control totals that preserve financial, operational, and referential integrity.
* Plan retirement, archival, access, and support arrangements for legacy data and applications that will not move into the future environment.

**Analytics data services and application enablement**

* Support the architecture and ongoing operation of NetSuite Analytics Warehouse and related analytics capabilities where adopted.
* Define the appropriate roles of NetSuite native reporting, governed analytical platforms, Power BI, and other reporting tools so business logic is not recreated inconsistently.
* Design data models and pipelines that provide trusted reporting and reconcile to source transactions.
* Support approved extension platforms for internal tools, portals, and workflows, and enable automation or AI only through governed data, controlled interfaces, clear ownership, and appropriate human review.

**Testing monitoring security and operational support**

* Develop and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, failure-mode, cutover, and reconciliation testing with documented acceptance criteria.
* Implement logging, automated alerts, transaction tracing, exception queues, retry mechanisms, dashboards, and escalation procedures so failures are visible and actionable.
* Perform hands-on production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across systems, data, network, authentication, mapping, sequencing, and business-rule layers.
* Apply secure access and data protection while establishing standards for source control, code review, automated testing, environment separation, deployment, versioning, rollback, documentation, and change control.

**Long term architecture ownership**

* Become a primary internal owner for enterprise integrations, data pipelines, interface standards, and supporting technical documentation.
* Work side by side with implementation-partner engineers during design and build activities rather than receiving knowledge only at the end of the program.
* Build internal support capability, reduce unnecessary dependence on external consultants, and prioritize technical debt and enhancements based on business value, reliability, control risk, total cost, and operational impact.
* Create scalable patterns that support growth, acquisition integration, customer and vendor enablement, analytics, automation, and future digital services

**Qualifications:**

* More than 7 years of enterprise application integration, software engineering, data engineering, or related technical experience.
* Meaningful hands-on experience integrating with NetSuite and working with its records, transactions, permissions, APIs, or scripting capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, SQL, SFTP, webhooks, authentication, and modern integration patterns.
* Experience designing, building, testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production integrations and data pipelines.
* Experience with data mapping, transformation, migration, reconciliation, master data, and data-quality controls.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills across applications, interfaces, data, security, and business processes.
* Experience with API security, token-based authentication, source control, code review, testing, deployment, environment management, and operational documentation.
* Ability to understand order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, fulfillment, and accounting impacts in addition to technical specifications.
* Ability to evaluate and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations and assume ownership of the resulting design.
* Strong written communication and willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operation of the environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), NetSuite Integration Platform, and other Oracle integration technologies.
* Experience with SuiteTalk, SuiteScript, RESTlets, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, or NetSuite Analytics Warehouse.
* Knowledge of EDI standards and third-party integration processes.
* Experience in food distribution, wholesale distribution, retail, logistics, or other transaction-intensive industries.
* Experience modernizing Microsoft Dynamics GP or custom legacy applications.
* Familiarity with Oracle APEX, Power BI, cloud data platforms, workflow automation, or document processing.
* Experience with multi-entity environments, acquisitions, and high-volume order and inventory transactions.

**Why Join Relay Human Cloud? ✨**

🌍 Opportunities to work with global clients

🤝 Dynamic and collaborative work environment

⚖️ Excellent work-life balance – 5-day workweek

🩺 Comprehensive health & accident insurance

🌴 Generous paid time off and holidays

🍽️ Complimentary lunches & dinners

🏆 Quarterly, Semi-Annual & Annual recognition, rewards, and giveaways

📚 Employee development programs – Communication, Soft Skills, and more

🎉 Vibrant cultural events – Fun Fridays, Month-End Celebrations, Sports Tournaments, and Festival celebrations

🎯 Excellent Employee Referral Program

* Collaborate with developers on technical implementation, code reviews, problem-solving, and features Delivery.

* Implement application security measures, including authentication, authorization, JWT validation, and secure service-to-service communication.
* Apply performance optimization techniques, including caching, rate limiting, database query optimization, and efficient resource utilization.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, refactoring, test creation, and documentation while maintaining code quality and security.
* Troubleshoot complex applications, database, networking, performance, and production issues.

Familiarity with time and space complexity (Big O notation), algorithmic efficiency, and selecting appropriate approaches to solve practical engineering problems.

Ability to mentor developers and conduct effective code reviews

title: Elixir Developer
description:
About Jetbro
  
Jetbro is a technology consulting and systems integration firm that builds reliable, scalable digital systems for organizations where technology is central to operations. We work across custom product development, enterprise applications, and infrastructure-led digital transformation for clients ranging from Fortune 500 companies to high-growth startups across India, Australia, and Canada.
  
  
Our philosophy is simple: build systems that work quietly, predictably, and under pressure. We value clarity over complexity and reliability over noise.
  
About the Role
  
We are looking for an Elixir Developer to join our team building backend services for scalable, production-grade applications. This is not a role where you simply execute PRDs. Instead, you will be a business-minded engineer who deeply understands the product use cases, business objectives, and strategic implications of technical decisions.
  
  
You will design and extend backend services using the Ash Framework, working across resources, actions, and data layers to ship features fast without sacrificing correctness. Our backend is Elixir/Phoenix with Ash as the core application framework, backed by PostgreSQL, deployed on Fly.io. You will spend most of your time inside Ash's resource-oriented patterns rather than hand-rolling boilerplate.
  
  
This is a framework-deep role with a business-first mindset. You will actively collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, and leadership to understand the why behind features, ask clarifying questions, and contribute to strategic technical decisions. You will use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as everyday tools, and you'll also work hands-on with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini) to build AI-powered features, not just use AI to write code. We expect you to be proficient with them, not just familiar.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Business & Product Collaboration:
  

* Work closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases, market context, and business objectives before diving into technical implementation
* Ask critical questions about business impact, trade-offs, and long-term implications of technical decisions
* Communicate technical constraints, risks, and opportunities in business-friendly language to non-technical stakeholders
* Contribute to architectural and strategic decisions by providing context on how technical choices affect business outcomes

Technical Design & Development:
  

* Design and build Ash resources, actions, calculations, and policies for core product features with a deep understanding of their business purpose
* Write clean, testable Elixir code following OTP and Phoenix conventions
* Build interactive, real-time UI where needed using Phoenix LiveView
* Design and maintain PostgreSQL schemas, migrations, and query performance with business scalability in mind
* Build and extend APIs (GraphQL/REST via AshGraphql/AshJsonApi or Phoenix controllers) that serve real production traffic

AI & Advanced Features:
  

* Integrate LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini) and vector databases into product features (semantic search, embeddings, retrieval-based workflows)
* Use AI coding assistants effectively to accelerate development without sacrificing code quality
* Understand the business implications of AI-powered features and their impact on user experience and product strategy

Operations & Ownership:
  

* Instrument features with product analytics (PostHog) to track usage and inform iteration
* Maintain Docker-based dev containers for a consistent, reproducible local development setup
* Deploy, monitor, and scale services on Fly.io
* Own features end-to-end: from understanding requirements and business context to deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement
* Participate in production debugging, monitoring, and performance tuning with an eye toward business impact

Team & Process:
  

* Collaborate with frontend engineers, QA, product managers, and project leads in a cross-functional environment
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architecture decisions with a focus on business value
* Champion clear thinking and ownership mindset within the engineering team

What You'll Work On
  

* Resource-driven backend architecture using Ash (resources, actions, relationships, policies, calculations, aggregates)
* Workflow logic, versioning, and multi-step business processes modeled declaratively in Ash
* Real-time, interactive features built with Phoenix LiveView
* Vector DB-backed features such as semantic search, embeddings storage, and retrieval-augmented workflows
* Background jobs and async processing (Oban or similar)
* Database design, query optimization, and migrations in PostgreSQL
* Integration with third-party services and internal microservices
* Local development standardized via Docker and dev containers
* Deployment, release management, and scaling on Fly.io
* Production debugging, monitoring, and performance tuning

Tech Stack
  

* Languages: Elixir
* Frameworks: Phoenix, Phoenix LiveView, Ash Framework (AshPostgres, AshGraphql/AshJsonApi, Ash Authentication as applicable)
* Databases: PostgreSQL, Vector DB (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar)
* AI/LLM: Claude, Gemini (API-level integration), Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
* Analytics: PostHog
* Infrastructure: Fly.io, Docker, Dev Containers, CI/CD pipelines
* Other: Oban/background jobs, GraphQL/REST APIs, Git

Requirements
  
  
Who is this Role for?
  
This role is a great fit if you:
  
  
Technical Foundation:
  

* Have hands-on experience with Elixir, and specifically the Ash Framework (not just Phoenix alone)
* Understand Ash's resource/action/policy model well enough to extend it, not just follow existing patterns
* Have built real-time or interactive features with Phoenix LiveView
* Have worked with vector databases and understand embeddings, similarity search, and retrieval patterns
* Have integrated LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, or similar) into production features, not just used them as coding tools
* Are comfortable using product analytics tools like PostHog to inform engineering decisions\
* Are comfortable working in Docker-based dev container environments
* Have experience deploying and operating applications on Fly.io (or similar platforms)
* Actively use AI coding assistants and understand their strengths and limits
* Care about writing code that other people can read and maintain

Business & Collaboration Mindset:
  

* Genuinely enjoy understanding the business context behind features, not just executing specifications
* Are comfortable asking "why" and challenging assumptions to ensure decisions align with business goals
* Have experience collaborating with product, business, and non-technical stakeholders
* Can translate between technical and business language effectively
* Enjoy working on systems that serve real users at real scale and care about user impact
* Demonstrate ownership mindset: you think about long-term implications, not just shipping code
* Learn fast and don't need to be told twice
* Are curious about how your work affects the broader business and product strategy

What we care more about than your resume
  

* Real Ash Framework experience > general Elixir/Phoenix experience alone
* Business acumen and product thinking > years of experience
* Communication and collaboration skills > individual technical prowess
* AI-fluency (both as a coding tool and as a feature you build) > years of experience
* Clear thinking and strategic mindset > buzzwords
* Ownership mindset and business impact focus > following instructions
* Side projects, experiments, GitHub repos, or well-documented failures are a big plus

Bonus
  

* Experience with AshAdmin, AshStateMachine, or AshPaperTrail
* Experience building RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) pipelines
* Exposure to observability tooling (Grafana, Prometheus, or similar)
* Experience in product-driven or cross-functional engineering environments
* Familiarity with Specification-Driven Development (SDD) or similar methodologies

Benefits
  
  
Growth at Jetbro
  

If you do well, this role can grow into:

* Senior Backend Engineer
* Platform / Infrastructure Engineer
* System Architect (longer term)

We invest heavily in people who invest in learning.

title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering

title: OEE Systems & Manufacturing Performance Specialist
description:
*Our world depends on rocks, minerals, metals and other raw materials – the building blocks of modern society. As an industry leader, Metso helps transform these essential materials to enable sustainable modern life.*
*Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources.*
*Join nearly 18,000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you’re supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration.*
*This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible.*
**Introduction**
We are looking for an
**OEE Systems & Manufacturing Performance Specialist**
to support and continuously improve our OEE platform across our manufacturing sites. In this role, you will help ensure reliable system performance, accurate production data, and useful insights that drive operational improvements.
  
  
The role can be located at any of our main Consumables manufacturing sites. We support hybrid ways of working, while regular presence at the local manufacturing site is expected to encourage collaboration and relationship building.
  
  
**Team you belong to**
You will join an international manufacturing environment focused on digitalization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. You will collaborate with manufacturing teams, internal IT, application support, software suppliers, and manufacturing analytics teams. You will report to the Director, Manufacturing Execution Processes.
  
  
In this role, you will connect factory operations with technical teams, helping turn systems and manufacturing data into value for the business.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the day-to-day administration and operational support of the OEE platform across manufacturing sites, acting as a trainer and subject-matter expert for factory users and key stakeholders
* Monitor and manage data flows from production equipment and shop-floor systems into the OEE platform, analytics, and reporting solutions, ensuring accurate and reliable manufacturing data
* Coordinate ERP integration with OEE and MES systems, including production-order and operation-confirmation data flows, interface testing, validation, monitoring, and troubleshooting
* Coordinate the onboarding and connection of new production equipment, including requirements definition, testing, validation, documentation, and handover to operations
* Troubleshoot system, software, interface, configuration, and data-quality issues in collaboration with internal IT teams and external software suppliers, while ensuring consistent and correct OEE system usage
* Analyze availability, performance, and quality losses to identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to common standards, training materials, system enhancements, manufacturing digitalization, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

**Who You Are**

* You have a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial Management, Information Systems, Automation, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* You understand manufacturing operations, production processes, equipment behavior, and production losses, with experience in OEE, MES, manufacturing data systems, industrial digitalization, or similar production-performance solutions.
* You understand equipment connectivity and data flows between machines, shop-floor solutions, ERP systems, business applications, and reporting platforms, including interface testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* You have strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills and are comfortable resolving technical and data-quality issues with IT teams and external software suppliers
* You are a confident communicator and trainer who can work effectively with technical and operational stakeholders in an international, multi-site environment, and you have professional working proficiency in English.
* Experience with Power BI or similar analytics tools, Lean manufacturing, root-cause analysis, industrial automation, PLC, OPC, IoT, edge technologies, SQL, or machine integration is considered an advantage

**What's In It For You**

* An inspiring purpose - Enabling sustainable modern life. Minerals and metals are the backbone of essential functions in the modern world. However, there's a pressing need for more sustainable solutions to collect and process them. At Metso, you get to be part of transforming the industry and making a positive change.
* A thriving culture - We are committed to developing an inclusive culture that enables everyone to do their best and reach their full potential. A culture that is courageous, compelling, and caring, and unites our people to build a sustainable future together.
* Extensive learning opportunities - Ongoing growth dialogues, internal mobility, mentoring programs, education assistance, ambitious projects, and global opportunities.

title: Master Data, Technical Analyst (Evolve/Precisely)
description:

e.l.f. Beauty's purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip, and face.

We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry.
  
  
Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us
  
  
**Position Summary:**
The Precisely/Evolve MDM Analyst will serve as e.l.f. Beauty’s primary technical owner of the Precisely/Evolve platform, driving data quality, enrichment, and master data management across customer, vendor, and product domains. This is a platform-forward role for someone who is hands-on with Precisely/Evolve workflows and brings the analytical mindset to continuously improve data health at scale. Experience with SAP master data is strongly encouraged — the two platforms are closely linked in our environment — and candidates who bring dual platform fluency will have a meaningful advantage. The ideal hire is proactive, technically sharp, and eager to build and improve, not just maintain.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Precisely/Evolve Platform - Primary Focus**

* Own the administration, configuration, and ongoing optimization of Precisely/Evolve for data quality, enrichment, matching, and survivorship across customer, vendor, and product master domains
* Design, build, test, and deploy data quality rules, enrichment workflows, and matching/survivorship logic within the Precisely/Evolve platform
* Monitor pipeline performance, proactively identify processing gaps or failures, and implement improvements to accuracy and throughput
* Evaluate and adopt new Precisely/Evolve features and product updates relevant to e.l.f.’s data environment
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for all Precisely/Evolve workflows, configurations, and data quality rules
* Serve as the internal subject matter expert on the Precisely/Evolve platform, supporting onboarding, training, and troubleshooting for business and IT users

**MDM Domain Knowledge — Required Foundation**

* Apply master data management principles across customer, vendor, and product domains to define what “good data” looks like — including data standards, field-level rules, hierarchy structures, and source-of-truth logic
* Design matching and survivorship rules grounded in business context: understanding which record wins, why, and what the downstream impact is if that logic is wrong
* Develop and enforce data quality thresholds by domain, with clear understanding of business consequences for each type of quality failure
* Partner with data owners to define and document master data standards that translate directly into platform configuration

**Cross-Domain Data Stewardship**
  
  

+ Apply technical and domain expertise across all three master data domains — customer, vendor, and product — ensuring consistency, completeness, and accuracy across platforms and downstream systems
+ Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT to understand domain-specific requirements and translate them into technical rules, validation logic, and platform configuration
+ Collaborate with IT on integration design to ensure Precisely/Evolve outputs flow correctly into connected systems including SAP

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience with Precisely (formerly Syncsort/Trillium) or Evolve, including workflow configuration, data quality rule development, and platform administration — required
* Demonstrated MDM domain knowledge across one or more of the following: customer master, vendor master, product/material master — required. Breadth across all three is a strong plus
* Ability to design matching, survivorship, and enrichment logic from first principles — not just execute pre-built configurations — required
* Experience with SAP master data management (Material Master, Customer Master, and/or Vendor Master) strongly preferred; dual Precisely/Evolve + SAP experience is a significant differentiator
* Proven ability to identify data quality gaps and proactively drive platform or process improvements
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to data detail and integrity
* Ability to work cross-functionally with business and IT teams, translating technical concepts clearly for non-technical audiences
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to collaborate effectively across time zones with global teams
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP MDG (Master Data Governance), or data integration middleware a plus
* Beauty, retail, or consumer packaged goods industry background preferred but not required

**Technical Skills**

* Precisely/Evolve — workflow configuration, data quality rules, enrichment, matching, and survivorship (required)
* MDM domain knowledge — customer, vendor, and/or product/material master (required)
* SAP ERP / S/4HANA — Material Master, Customer Master, and/or Vendor Master (strongly preferred)
* SQL or equivalent querying tools for data analysis and investigation
* Data integration concepts and API-based or batch data flows
* Microsoft Excel (advanced) for data analysis, reconciliation, and reporting

*This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this position. It also reflects the general details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job identified, and shall not be considered, as detailed description of all the work required inherent in the job. It is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities, and it is subject to changes and exceptions at the supervisors’ discretion.*

title: Senior Implementation Consultant – EHR / EMR / HIS
description:
📍 India | UK business hours

🧠 Typically 3–8 years’ relevant experience

📅 Notice periods up to 45 days welcome

🚀 Bring your EHR expertise to the next generation of private healthcare

You know how healthcare software works. You can understand a customer’s workflows, design the right configuration, explain the product confidently and take an implementation through to go-live.

Now imagine owning that entire journey—and remaining the person the customer trusts as their business grows.

Script Assist is hiring a
**Senior Implementation Consultant**
with experience implementing, configuring and optimising Electronic Health Record (EHR), Electronic Medical Record (EMR), Electronic Patient Record (EPR) or Hospital Information System (HIS / HMIS) platforms.

We are particularly interested in professionals with experience across Oracle Health / Cerner, eClinicalWorks, Altera / Allscripts, Epic, NextGen Healthcare, InterSystems TrakCare, MEDITECH, athenahealth, Dedalus or comparable healthcare software.

You may currently work at an EHR vendor, a healthcare technology company, or within the healthcare technology consulting teams of PwC, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, Accenture, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, HCLTech or CitiusTech.

If you built your product expertise at an EHR vendor and subsequently moved into healthcare technology consulting, we would particularly like to hear from you.

**🏥 About Script Assist**

Script Assist is building the technology and operating infrastructure behind next-generation private healthcare in the UK.

Our platform already supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month, with established scale in medical cannabis and expansion into ADHD, weight management, longevity and specialist private medicine.

We bring together the workflows that clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators need to run their services:

• Patient onboarding and patient portals

• Clinical consultations and scheduling

• Prescribing and repeat prescriptions

• Pharmacy, dispensing and inventory

• Payments and operational workflows

• Patient communications, reporting and integrations

Every customer operates differently. Your role is to understand those differences, design the right solution and help each customer get the best from Script Assist.

You will work directly with UK healthcare customers and closely with our leadership, Product and Engineering teams—with real influence over customer delivery and product development.

**🎯 The opportunity**

You will become a product expert and trusted client lead for UK clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators.

You will understand their operations, design their workflows, configure their solution, demonstrate the product, train their teams and guide them through implementation.

After go-live, you will retain ownership of the relationship, helping customers resolve problems, improve adoption and develop how they use the platform.

The role brings together:

• EHR implementation and functional consulting

• Clinical and operational workflow design

• Application configuration and solution design

• Client workshops, product demonstrations and training

• UAT, go-live and post-implementation optimisation

• Ongoing client ownership and stakeholder management

**⚙️ What you will own**

Workflow discovery and functional solution design

• Lead client discovery sessions and requirements workshops.

• Map clinical and operational processes into clear system workflows.

• Translate requirements into configuration decisions, functional specifications and acceptance criteria.

• Advise customers on how to use the product effectively.

• Identify dependencies, explain trade-offs and challenge requirements constructively.

EHR application configuration

• Configure or lead the configuration of modules, forms, clinical templates, user roles, permissions, rules and system settings.

• Understand how configuration decisions affect the wider patient, clinician and pharmacy journey.

• Work across registration, appointments, clinical documentation, prescribing, medication management, work queues, patient portals and payments.

• Identify which requirements can be met through configuration and which need integration or product development.

Implementation and go-live

• Own customer delivery from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, training and go-live.

• Coordinate data migration, integrations and customer dependencies with specialist teams.

• Lead UAT preparation, issue resolution and go-live readiness.

• Deliver product demonstrations, workflow walkthroughs and user training.

• Manage hypercare and the transition into ongoing platform use.

Client consulting and relationship ownership

• Lead meetings with clinicians, operational managers and senior healthcare stakeholders.

• Explain system behaviour and recommendations clearly and confidently.

• Manage expectations, priorities, actions and escalations.

• Maintain a detailed understanding of each customer’s workflows, configuration and objectives.

• Build lasting relationships through product knowledge, sound judgement and reliable follow-through.

Post-implementation optimisation

• Remain directly involved after go-live.

• Improve adoption, workflows, configuration and user confidence.

• Diagnose issues involving permissions, data, configuration, training, integrations or software behaviour.

• Translate product gaps into clear requirements for Product and Engineering.

• Validate fixes and follow issues through to resolution.

**✅ The experience we are looking for**

• Typically 3–8 years of relevant EHR, EMR, EPR, HIS or clinical information systems experience. Strong candidates outside this range are welcome.

• Deep functional knowledge of at least one substantial healthcare software platform.

• Personal involvement in system configuration or detailed configuration design.

• Experience delivering implementations or substantial optimisation projects for external healthcare customers.

• Direct responsibility for client workshops, requirements discussions, training or implementation decisions.

• Confidence investigating application and workflow problems.

• Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, QA and Support.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to independently lead senior UK client conversations.

• A hands-on approach and enthusiasm for learning a complex healthcare product.

**🔎 Relevant platforms and backgrounds**

We welcome experience with:

• Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium

• eClinicalWorks / eCW

• Altera Digital Health / Allscripts, including Sunrise and TouchWorks

• Veradigm

• Epic

• NextGen Healthcare / NextGen Enterprise

• InterSystems TrakCare

• MEDITECH / Expanse

• athenahealth / athenaOne

• Dedalus

• PracticeSuite, MicroMD, Napier, Ohum and other substantial EHR / EMR / HIS platforms

Relevant functional experience may include ambulatory care, outpatient workflows, patient administration, scheduling, clinical documentation, electronic prescribing, medication management, pharmacy, patient engagement and practice management.

Experience working with US, UK or other international healthcare customers is particularly valuable.

Relevant current or previous roles

Your title may be:

• Implementation Consultant / Senior Implementation Consultant

• Functional Consultant / Senior Functional Consultant

• Clinical Consultant / Clinical Applications Consultant

• Application Consultant / Application Specialist

• Delivery Consultant / Senior Associate Delivery Consultant

• EMR Consultant / EHR Consultant

• Clinical Information System Consultant

• Implementation Project Manager / EMR Project Manager

• Post Implementation Project Manager

• Implementation Manager / Client Onboarding Manager

• Product Specialist / Solution Consultant

• Healthcare Technology Consultant / Senior Associate

Candidates in EHR product ownership, business analysis or strategic client delivery are also welcome where their experience includes substantial configuration knowledge and personal implementation responsibility.

**🌟 Why join Script Assist?**

• Own the customer journey from initial requirements to long-term platform success.

• Apply your EHR expertise across a growing range of private healthcare services.

• Work directly with UK healthcare customers and senior decision-makers.

• Stay close to the product, with direct access to Product, Engineering and leadership.

• See your recommendations become working solutions used by real healthcare teams.

• Help shape both customer delivery and the platform itself.

**📍 Location, working hours and joining**

• Based in India.

• Available Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 UK time, including a one-hour break.

• UK summer hours: 13:30–22:30 IST.

• UK winter hours: 14:30–23:30 IST.

• Candidates able to join within 45 days are welcome.

**Interested?**

Please ensure your CV clearly identifies the EHR platforms and modules you have worked with, your personal configuration responsibilities, and the client implementations or optimisation projects you have owned.

We would love to hear how you could bring that expertise to Script Assist.

title: Senior Engineer - Design Verification
description:
**About SiFive**
*As the pioneers who introduced RISC-V to the world, SiFive is transforming the future of compute by bringing the limitless potential of RISC-V to the highest performance and most data-intensive applications in the world. SiFive’s unrivaled compute platforms are continuing to enable leading technology companies around the world to innovate, optimize and deliver the most advanced solutions of tomorrow across every market segment of chip design, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, automotive, data center, mobile, and consumer. With SiFive, the future of RISC-V has no limits.*
At SiFive, we are always excited to connect with talented individuals, who are just as passionate about driving innovation and changing the world as we are.
  
  
Our constant innovation and ongoing success is down to our amazing teams of incredibly talented people, who collaborate and support each other to come up with truly groundbreaking ideas and solutions. Solutions that will have a huge impact on people's lives; making the world a better place, one processor at a time.
  
  
Are you ready?
  
  
To learn more about SiFive’s phenomenal success and to see why we have won the GSA’s prestigious Most Respected Private Company Award (for the fourth time!), check out our website and Glassdoor pages.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**About The Role**
SiFive is looking for a Senior Design Verification Engineer to drive verification of a next-generation cache-coherent interconnect subsystem used in high-performance SoCs.
  
  
This is a T3 / Senior Engineer individual-contributor role within the Interconnect horizontal area, focused on coherent interconnect and related subsystem behavior.
  
  
In this role, you will work across architecture, RTL, formal, and design verification teams to verify coherent data movement, protocol correctness, ordering, flow control, quality-of-service behavior, and subsystem integration across multiple interface types and bridge paths.
  
  
We are looking for someone who can independently execute high-quality verification work, build robust environments, debug complex issues efficiently, and contribute to stronger verification methodology across the broader interconnect verification effort.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Understand the coherent interconnect architecture and create effective verification strategies and test plans for the assigned area.
* Develop and maintain verification environments, checkers, scoreboards, assertions, stimulus, and coverage models for coherent traffic, ordering rules, backpressure, flow control, buffering behavior, and error handling.
* Verify subsystem behavior across interface boundaries, protocol adaptation layers, and bridge paths, including conversion, buffering, deinterleaving, and related data-movement behavior.
* Define and execute directed and constrained-random tests that expose corner cases in coherency, concurrency, ordering, credits, arbitration, QoS behavior, and integration scenarios.
* Analyze failures, isolate root cause, and drive fixes across RTL, assertions, testbench infrastructure, and test content.
* Collaborate closely with architecture, design, formal, and software teams to clarify requirements, review specifications, and improve verification quality early in the development cycle.
* Write functional coverage, analyze coverage results, and close coverage holes to ensure verification completeness and signoff quality.
* Contribute reusable methodology, automation, and debug improvements that raise team-wide productivity and verification quality.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in IP, subsystem, or SoC functional verification, preferably in coherent interconnect, cache, memory-system, or CPU-subsystem verification.
* Strong hands-on experience with SystemVerilog and UVM-based verification.
* Solid understanding of cache-coherent systems, on-chip interconnects, memory-subsystem behavior, and verification of ordering and flow-control semantics.
* Experience creating test plans, building testbenches, writing assertions, analyzing coverage, and debugging complex design issues.
* Experience verifying protocol behavior such as ordering, backpressure, buffering, arbitration, flow control, and error handling.
* Strong debugging skills and the ability to root-cause issues across specification, RTL, and verification environment layers.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively across architecture, design, and verification teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience verifying coherent interconnect, NoC, cache, or memory-subsystem functionality in multicore or high-performance SoCs.
* Experience with subsystem integration and protocol interactions across multiple interfaces or bridge paths.
* Familiarity with one or more industry protocols such as AXI, CHI, ACE, CXL, UCIe, or similar high-performance interface standards.
* Familiarity with scripting and automation using Python or similar languages.
* Experience with formal verification, performance-oriented verification, or emulation / FPGA-assisted debug.

title: SENIOR ELECTRONICS ENGINEER (FIRMWARE)
description:
**ABOUT US**

Join a team that is redefining the accessibility of space. Azista space is a transformative force in the global aerospace sector, uniquely positioned at the intersection of indigenous innovation and industrial scalability. Operating India’s first private-sector satellite mass-production facility in Ahmedabad, we have bridged the gap between complex engineering and high-volume manufacturing.

As a vertically integrated leader, we provide end-to-end solutions from the precision design of satellite buses and advanced payloads to mission management and communication systems. We don’t just build hardware, we are democratizing the final frontier by providing global clientele with the cost-effective, high-performance technology needed to power the next generation of orbital missions. At Azista, you won't just be starting a job, you’ll be fuelling the future of space exploration.

**JOB SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to own the design, development, and verification of high-reliability firmware for our microcontroller-based satellite subsystems. In this role, you will work at the intersection of bare-metal software development and cutting-edge hardware, converting complex aerospace requirements into robust, high-performance C code.

As a key member of our engineering division, you will directly drive firmware architecture, schematic integration, and bench-level debugging. Your ownership will directly impact sub-system reliability, hardware-software integration speed, and the overall execution of our active low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite platforms.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Firmware Architecture & Design:**
  Architect, write, and debug bare-metal and low-level embedded C firmware for ARM 32-bit microcontroller systems powering satellite payloads and sub-systems.
* **Hardware-Software Integration:**
  Review hardware schematics, block diagrams, and datasheets to bring up board support packages (BSPs) and implement device drivers for analog and digital peripherals.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner closely with hardware design, thermal, and systems engineering teams to translate high-level mission requirements into optimal firmware features.
* **Hardware Bench Debugging:**
  Perform root-cause analysis, hardware bring-up, and physical debugging using DSOs (Digital Storage Oscilloscopes), logic analyzers, and multimeters.
* **Protocol & Bus Implementation:**
  Configure and optimize robust embedded communication interfaces including UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, RS232/RS485, and USB.
* **Quality & Lifecycle Management:**
  Maintain version control, maintain code standards (e.g., MISRA C guidelines), and write technical documentation, design notes, and test cases to ensure space-grade software reliability.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **Experience:**
  4–8 years of hands-on experience in embedded C firmware development for microcontroller-based systems.
* **Education:**
  BE / B.Tech / ME / M.Tech / M.Sc. in Electronics Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
* **Core Programming:**
  Expert proficiency in Embedded C and bare-metal programming without reliance on abstraction layers.
* **Hardware Understanding:**
  Solid grasp of digital and analog electronics concepts, including DAC/ADC interfaces and schematic reading.
* **Lab Equipment:**
  Hands-on experience troubleshooting, testing, and debugging hardware using DSOs, multimeters, and logic analyzers.

**PREFERRED / DESIRABLE SKILLS**

* **Microcontroller Expertise:**
  Direct experience with ARM 32-bit microcontrollers, specifically Microchip SAM V71 architectures and the MPLAB IDE ecosystem.
* **Code Quality & Standards:**
  Working knowledge of MISRA C compliance and defensive programming techniques for high-reliability systems.
* **Protocols:**
  Practical exposure to industrial and aerospace protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, RS232/RS485, USB).

**WHY JOIN US?**

* **Pioneer Space Tech:**
  Work directly on active satellite platforms inside India's first mass-production space facility.
* **Vertically Integrated Impact:**
  See your code move rapidly from design and bench testing to integrated satellite hardware orbiting Earth.
* **Engineering Excellence:**
  Collaborate with world-class engineers across hardware, thermal, payload, and mission control domains.
* **Career Acceleration:**
  Scale your skills in a high-growth sector with continuous exposure to complex, space-grade embedded systems.
* **Competitive Package:**
  Attractive salary, comprehensive health benefits, and a culture that celebrates technical innovation and autonomy.

title: Google Apps Script Developer (Ecommerce Automation)
description:
**Devsatva LLP**

📍 [Ahmedabad] · Full-time · 1+ years experience

**About us**

Devsatva LLP is an AI-native data engineering and analytics consultancy. We build real-time data pipelines, agentic AI workflows, and MarTech automation for clients including Singapore Airlines, Unilever India, and Billabong High. We’re a small, senior team — you’ll own problems end to end.

**The role**

We’re building Google Workspace–based inventory and order management tooling for sellers operating across Amazon, Walmart, and other marketplaces. Think: live inventory syncing across channels, order and settlement reconciliation, low-stock and overselling alerts, bulk listing updates — all driven from Sheets that operations teams can actually use day to day.

You’ll be the person who makes those systems reliable. Marketplace APIs are rate-limited, inconsistent, and occasionally hostile; the job is to build around that so the warehouse team never sees a stale number.

**What you’ll do**

* Build inventory sync engines in Apps Script that keep stock levels accurate across Amazon, Walmart, and other sales channels
* Integrate marketplace APIs — Amazon SP-API, Walmart Marketplace API, and others — handling auth, pagination, throttling, and retries
* Automate order ingestion, fulfilment status updates, returns, and settlement reconciliation into Sheets and BigQuery
* Build bulk listing and price update workflows, including feed submission and status polling
* Set up alerting for stockouts, overselling risk, failed feeds, and API errors — so problems surface before clients notice
* Design around Apps Script’s execution limits: batching, time-driven triggers, resumable jobs, caching
* Work with our data engineers to graduate mature automations into the wider pipeline

**What we’re looking for**

* 1+ years of hands-on Google Apps Script experience (share examples or a repo)
* Strong JavaScript fundamentals — ES6+, async patterns, clean modular code
* Real experience consuming REST APIs: OAuth 2.0, signed requests, pagination, rate limits, idempotency
* Deep Google Sheets knowledge — formulas, named ranges, data validation, and where it starts to break at scale
* Understanding of Apps Script quotas and execution limits, and how to design systems that survive them
* Git, and the habit of using it

**Strongly preferred**

* Prior work with Amazon SP-API, Walmart Marketplace API, Shopify, or similar ecommerce platforms
* Familiarity with ecommerce operations concepts: SKU mapping, FBA vs FBM, multi-warehouse stock, ASINs, feeds, buy box
* BigQuery or Looker Studio for reporting on top of the operational data

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Embedded Linux Engineer to join our Robotics engineering team. You will be responsible for bringing up custom-designed processor boards, developing Linux device drivers, optimizing kernel performance, and ensuring a stable platform for application development. The ideal candidate has a strong "hacker" mindset, loves working close to the metal, and thrives on solving complex hardware-software integration problems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Board Bring-Up: Perform initial board bring-up on new, custom-designed processor boards (custom ARM/RISC-V).
* Linux Kernel/BSP Development: Customize, configure, and maintain the Linux kernel, bootloader (U-Boot), and Board Support Package (BSP) for custom hardware.
* Driver Development: Write, debug, and optimize low-level Linux device drivers for on-chip and off-chip peripherals (e.g., I2C, SPI, UART, PCIe, Ethernet, GPIO).
* Device Tree: Develop and maintain Device Tree Source (DTS/DTB) files to map hardware peripherals to Linux drivers.
* System Optimization: Optimize system boot time, memory usage, and performance on constrained custom hardware.
* Debugging: Troubleshoot complex system crashes, kernel panics, and hardware-software interaction issues using JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
* Build Systems: Create and maintain custom embedded Linux distributions using Yocto Project or Buildroot.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 3-7+ years of professional experience in embedded Linux software development.
* Languages: Strong proficiency in C/C++ programming for embedded systems; scripting experience in Python or Bash.
* Kernel Knowledge: Deep understanding of Linux kernel internals, including memory management, interrupts, and concurrency management.
* Hardware Familiarity: Ability to read hardware schematics and component datasheets to derive software solutions.
* Tools: Proficient with Git, GDB, and JTAG debugging tools.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with ARM Cortex-A/M or RISC-V architectures.

Experience contributing to the mainline Linux kernel or open-source community.

Knowledge of secure boot and hardware security modules (HSM).

Experience with real-time Linux patches (PREEMPT\_RT).

Integration with external web-based platforms

Browser-based interactions and data processing

Communication and synchronisation with the core CRM via APIs.

**PHP, Laravel and Filament**

TypeScript / JavaScript

**Puppeteer and browser automation**

MySQL/Postgres, APIs and third-party integrations

GitHub and maintaining existing codebases

Laravel Cloud experience would be beneficial

The platform is already substantially developed, so the requirement is to continue the existing development, complete outstanding functionality and provide ongoing maintenance, enhancements and technical support.

Our client has emphasised on having a strong practical experience with TypeScript and Puppeteer, particularly around the performance, reliability and optimisation of existing integrations.

One additional area worth highlighting is Cloudflare experience, particularly R2 object storage, as this forms part of our existing infrastructure.

description:
**About Oizom** 


 Oizom builds environmental monitoring hardware and software — air quality, noise, vibration, and gas\-sensing products deployed in the field across multiple markets. Our product line spans Polludrone (ambient air quality), Sonicbot (Class 1 noise monitoring), Seismibot (ground vibration), OGS (electrochemical gas sensing), Sensorbox, and AirOwl (our open\-source ESP32\-based air quality monitor). Our R\&D team spans Industrial Design, Design Engineering, Embedded Hardware, and Embedded Firmware.
 



**Role Summary** 


 We're hiring a Senior Firmware Engineer to lead our embedded firmware team. This is a hybrid role: roughly half hands\-on architecture and development across our MCU and embedded\-Linux product lines, and half technical leadership — mentoring junior engineers, setting coding and review standards, and owning firmware delivery across multiple concurrent product programs.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 

**Technical leadership** 



* Lead and mentor a team of 3–5 junior/mid firmware engineers — code reviews, design reviews, and hands\-on pairing
* Own firmware architecture decisions across product lines and make the build\-vs\-buy, framework, and platform calls
* Set and enforce firmware coding standards, version control practices, and release processes
* Plan and track firmware workstreams against product timelines; report status to the Head of R\&D



**Hands\-on development** 



* Develop and maintain firmware for ESP32/ESP32\-S3\-based products (sensor readout, connectivity, power management)
* Develop and maintain firmware for STM32\-based products (bare\-metal or RTOS, sensor interfacing, real\-time measurement paths)
* Build and maintain Python\-based firmware/application software for Raspberry Pi CM4\-based products (config\-driven sensor drivers, Modbus/serial interfacing, BLE, edge processing)
* Containerize and deploy services using Docker (on\-device services and supporting cloud/data pipelines)
* Implement and debug communication protocols: I2C, SPI, UART, RS\-485/Modbus RTU, SDI\-12, MQTT, BLE
* Work closely with Embedded Hardware and Design Engineering on bring\-up, debugging, and DFM feedback loops

* 6–9 years of professional embedded firmware development experience, including at least 1–2 years in a lead or mentoring capacity
* Strong C/C\+\+ firmware development on
 
**ESP32** 

 (Arduino or ESP\-IDF) and
 
**STM32** 

 (bare\-metal or an RTOS such as FreeRTOS)
* Strong
 
**Python 3** 

 for embedded Linux application/firmware work on
 
**Raspberry Pi CM4** 

 or similar SBCs
* Practical experience with
 
**Docker** 

 — containerizing device\-side services and/or supporting data pipelines
* Solid grasp of embedded communication protocols: I2C, SPI, UART, and at least one of RS\-485/Modbus RTU, SDI\-12, or MQTT
* Hands\-on experience with wireless/cellular connectivity:
 
**Quectel 4G/LTE modules** 

 (AT command interfacing),
 
**LoRa** 

 ,
 
**WiFi** 

 , and
 
**BLE** 

 stacks
* Comfortable with hardware\-level debugging: JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, reading schematics and datasheets
* Git\-based version control and structured code review practices
* Demonstrated ability to lead a small team — planning work, unblocking others, and maintaining code quality without micromanaging


**Nice to Have** 
* Experience with sensor\-heavy or field\-deployed IoT products (environmental, industrial, or similar harsh\-environment hardware)
* Experience with cellular modules (e.g., Telit/Quectel LTE) and connectivity recovery/watchdog design
* Familiarity with a self\-hosted data stack (e.g., MQTT broker, Telegraf/InfluxDB/Grafana) for device telemetry
* Exposure to analog front\-end or electrochemical/gas\-sensing signal chains
* Experience with BLE peripheral/central firmware
* Prior experience in a startup or small\-team R\&D environment where you owned outcomes end\-to\-end

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

****Essential Skills \& Experience****
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


****Desirable Skills \& Experience****
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.

* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.


**Benefits**
**Compensation:**
***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.

* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.

 Build and scale services for operational data ingestion, enrichment, storage, and query in a

 discovery and inventory data.

 stores.
