 streaming, scheduled polling cycles, bursty event traffic, and transactional API writes — each
 



 with different latency, ordering, and backpressure characteristics.

 conventions where they fit and defining consistent conventions where they don't, so
 



 downstream consumers see one shape regardless of source.

 model inference into the ingestion and query path within latency and resource budgets.
 



 Own system design for your modules — write and defend design notes covering data
 



 model, interfaces, scaling limits, failure modes, and rollback.
 



 • Debug production problems end to end — reproduce, isolate, instrument, and fix issues
 



 including performance regressions and platform\-specific behavior.
 



 • Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as part of the normal development loop,
 



 while retaining full ownership of correctness, security, and design quality of the generated
 



 output.

 to design and engineering documentation.
 



 • Collaborate with product managers, and fellow engineers to deliver high\-quality features.
 



 • Continuously learn and apply modern development practices and tools.

**•** 
 B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT

 ability and appetite to work in Rust.
 



 • Demonstrable experience in the observability domain: metrics, logs, traces, agents, collectors,
 



 monitoring systems, or telemetry pipelines.
 



 • Working knowledge of cloud and distributed systems — containers, Kubernetes, service\-to\-service
 



 communication, and the standard distributed failure modes (partial failure, backpressure, retries,
 



 idempotency).

description:
**About Us**
 Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI\-driven platform and expert\-led services. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real\-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X\-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
   

  

 Sophos offers industry\-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next\-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
   

  

 Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at www.sophos.com .
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a senior, hands\-on Zuora Billing Developer to own the build and evolution of our global subscription billing platform. You will design and deliver high\-quality configuration and technical solutions across product catalogue, subscriptions, billing and invoicing —combining configuration with API\-led integrations, automation, and data\-driven controls to deliver secure, scalable outcomes aligned to finance and go\-to\-market needs.
   

  

 In this role you will partner closely with Solution Architects, Business Systems Analysts, development teams and business teams to translate requirements into working features, integrations and automations. You will take end\-to\-end ownership from technical design and estimation through build, testing, release and production support, applying strong engineering discipline (versioning, peer review, documentation, operational readiness and runbooks). This is a high\-impact opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex billing challenges, improving platform reliability, and raising the bar for how we deliver change in Zuora Billing.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Enhance Zuora Billing capabilities using a hands\-on approach to configure and maintain Zuora product catalog, including rate plan charges (recurring, usage, one\-time), tiers, discounting, amendments, and proration behavior, aligned to agreed go\-to\-market models.
* Develop and maintain Zuora workflows and automations (e.g., billing runs, invoice generation, dunning, and operational processes) using standard platform features and best practices.
* Accelerate configuration, troubleshooting, and solution exploration using Zuora AI capabilities (e.g., Zuora AI chat/assistant and AI\-enabled workflow development features) while validating outputs for accuracy, security, and compliance.
* Design, build, and support integrations with upstream/downstream systems (e.g., Salesforce, SAP, data platforms, middleware) using Zuora APIs, event patterns, and agreed integration standards.
* Deliver technical designs, estimates, and delivery plans, and collaborate with Solution Architects and cross\-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements and propose scalable cross\-functional solutions.
* Promote engineering discipline across the team: testing, peer reviews, environment hygiene, and operational readiness; share knowledge and mentor junior colleagues where appropriate.
* Troubleshoot complex billing issues across configuration, data, and integrations; perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable fixes.
* Produce and maintain high\-quality technical documentation (solution notes, configuration rationale, runbooks, and support guides) and use AI tools (e.g., Copilot) to improve draft quality, structure, and completeness.
* Implement and support data migration and cutover activities (data mapping, load approach, reconciliation, and post\-load validation) for changes impacting Zuora Billing.


**What You Will Bring**
 Essential:
   

  

* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience implementing, maintaining and supporting Zuora Billing solutions (e.g. workflows, automations) in a production environment using standard features and following platform best practices (solution design, configuration and troubleshooting).
* Strong knowledge of core Zuora concepts: product catalogue, rate plan charges, subscriptions/amendments, proration, billing runs, invoicing, credit memos/debit memos, and common finance/billing controls.
* Proficiency with Zuora APIs and data access (e.g., REST APIs, Data Query) and solid understanding of integration patterns with CRM/ERP/middleware.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with evidence of root cause analysis across configuration, data, and integration issues.
* Practical experience using AI tools (e.g. Zuora AI, Zuora workflow AI, Microsoft Copilot) to accelerate development, documentation, research and to explore platform functionality, while applying sound judgement to verify accuracy and protect sensitive data.
* Experience producing technical documentation and operational runbooks that enable reliable support and knowledge transfer.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional technical and business teams in a global, matrixed environment.
* Professional maturity and ability to operate calmly in business\-critical situations, taking accountability through to resolution.


 Desirable
   

  

* Zuora certifications (e.g., Zuora Billing Administrator, Zuora Billing Consultant, or equivalent).
* Experience with complex go\-to\-market models (usage\-based pricing, ramp deals, multi\-entity, multi\-currency, mid\-term upgrades, renewals) and high\-volume billing operations.
* Experience of Zuora Revenue (RevPro) and revenue recognition principles, including upstream/downstream impacts from billing configuration.
* Knowledge of financial processes and controls, including tax, compliance, audit evidence, and reconciliation.
* Familiarity with agile delivery methodologies, CI/CD or DevOps practices for configuration/integration changes.
* Knowledge of IT security and architecture frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATT\&CK, TOGAF) and how they influence application design and integration choices.


 \#B2
   

  

**Ready to Join Us?**
 At Sophos, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives to fuel innovation. Research shows that candidates sometimes hesitate to apply if they don't check every box in a job description. We challenge that notion. Your unique experiences and skills might be exactly what we need to enhance our team. Don't let a checklist hold you back – we encourage you to apply.

description:
We are looking for Senior Software Engineers with 4–6 years of experience to join our Fintech engineering team. In this role, you will be split across two critical pillars of our financial ecosystem: building secure, high\-performance
 **customer\-facing applications** 
 and scaling our internal
 **back\-office transaction and operations management software** 
 .
 



 While our core ecosystem leverages the
 **MERN Stack, Next.js, and NestJS** 
 , we also maintain critical systems built on
 **Laravel** 
 . If you have strong JavaScript full\-stack skills and hands\-on experience with Laravel, this role offers the perfect environment to utilize your entire skillset while scaling secure financial products.
 



  





**🚀 Key Responsibilities** 



* **Fintech Product Delivery:** 
 Build and maintain responsive, highly secure customer\-facing web applications using Next.js and the MERN stack.
* **Back\-Office Engineering:** 
 Develop scalable back\-office systems, internal dashboards, and automated workflows using NestJS to support financial operations, risk management, and compliance teams.
* **Data Integrity \& Security:** 
 Design optimized database schemas, transaction models, and ledger records in PostgreSQL and MySQL, ensuring absolute data consistency and zero\-loss financial tracking.
* **API Ecosystems:** 
 Securely build and integrate internal RESTful/GraphQL APIs and third\-party financial services (e.g., payment gateways, KYC, banking networks).
* **Code Excellence:** 
 Maintain high test coverage (unit/integration tests) for mission\-critical payment loops, and perform regular code reviews.
* **Technical Mentorship:** 
 Guide junior and mid\-level engineers in building resilient backend microservices and sleek frontends.



  





**🛠️ Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* **Frontend Mastery:** 
 Advanced knowledge of React.js and Next.js (Server\-Side Rendering, App Router) with a focus on web performance, accessibility, and client\-side security.
* **Robust Backend Development:** 
 Deep experience with Node.js and building modular, enterprise\-grade architectures using NestJS.
* **Relational Database Expertise:** 
 Strong proficiency in writing complex, optimized queries, connection pooling, and indexing in PostgreSQL and MySQL.
* **Fintech Mindset:** 
 Solid understanding of financial application fundamentals, such as data encryption, secure token management, data audit trails, and handling concurrent transactions.
* **Tooling \& DevOps:** 
 Strong command over Git, Docker, and standard CI/CD deployment pipelines. Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP) is preferred.

title: Integration Developer
description:
**We're Hiring: Integration Developer** 




  





**📍 Ahmedabad, Gujarat — full\-time, on\-site \| 💼 0–2 Years** 




  





 Every system in the world is trying to talk to another one. Someone has to make that conversation happen.
 



 That's what we do. We build the integrations that let businesses and services across the UK, Ireland and beyond actually work — data moving cleanly between systems that were never designed to meet.
 



 We're looking for someone at the start of their career to come and learn how to do it properly.
 



  





**What you'll actually do** 




**Build and consume REST APIs. Work with SOAP services. Write PL/SQL that doesn't fall over. Learn Apache Camel and enterprise integration patterns from people who've been doing this for years. Move real data between real systems for real organisations — from week one, not after six months of shadowing.** 




**You'll break things in test. You'll fix them. That's how this works.** 




  





**What you bring** 



* Solid Java fundamentals — the rest we'll teach you
* Enough SQL to be dangerous, and the appetite to get properly good at it
* Curiosity about how systems fit together
* The confidence to say "I don't know yet" and then go find out



  





 Degree in CS, IT or Engineering — or you've taught yourself and can show us what you've built. Both count.
 



  





**🤖 AI\-friendly? That's a real advantage here.** 




 We're not precious about it. If you use AI tools to learn faster, debug smarter and write better code — and you understand what the code is doing rather than just pasting it — that's exactly the mindset we want. Bring it.
 



  





**Bonus, not blockers** 



* Apache Camel
* Spring Boot
* Docker
* Kafka
* Any cloud platform
* a GitHub with something interesting on it



  





**Why this one** 




 Real projects, not training exercises. Senior developers who'll actually sit with you — which is why this role is on\-site in Ahmedabad, five days a week. You learn this craft by turning to the person next to you, not by messaging them.
 



  





 A clear route to mid\-level and beyond. Competitive salary based on your experience. And a team where asking questions is the job, not an interruption.
 



  





 You'll know more in six months here than in two years somewhere that keeps you on maintenance tickets.
 



  





**📩 Interested?** 




**CV to** 
**careers@itouchvision.com** 
 — subject line "Integration Developer". Built something you're proud of? Send the link. We'll look.
 



  





 \#Hiring \#IntegrationDeveloper \#JavaJobs \#AhmedabadJobs \#TechCareers \#AI \#FresherJobs

 iTouchVision is a globally recognized cloud\-based service provider known for innovation and operational excellence.
